text:
Situation: Corvale East holds 41 units of sevoflurane 1 mL/mL 250 mL with daily use of 9, giving 4.6 days on hand. Corvale General holds 157 units of the same presentation with daily use of 8.5, giving 18.4 days on hand. Both sites' current supply is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack (NDC 72162224502). The rule‑based ranking selects transferring 37 units from Corvale General to Corvale East as the top option. After the transfer Corvale General would retain about two weeks of supply and Corvale East would reach approximately 9 days.

Why (FDA record): FDA's records show sevoflurane is not on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: No FDA shortage posting exists, so the buyer should execute the transfer and monitor daily use at both locations.

Recommended actions:
1. Pharmacy director approves the transfer request for 37 units of sevoflurane 1 mL/mL 250 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East.
2. Buyer executes the transfer and monitors daily use at both locations.

Not recommended: Purchasing from AbbVie Inc., Baxter Healthcare Company, Halocarbon Life Sciences LLC, or Lannett Company Inc. at this time because no FDA shortage listing exists and current inventory supports the internal transfer.
